description: Search IndiaMART products, browse a category, or look up public product and supplier pages. Filter by Indian city or state.

category.description: IndiaMART category slug or category URL, e.g. 'cotton-fabric' or 'https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/cotton-fabric.html'. Required for mode=browseCategory.
category.title: Category slug or URL

city.description: Keep only suppliers in this Indian city, e.g. 'Surat', 'Mumbai', 'Jaipur'. Works with searchProducts and browseCategory.
city.title: City

enrichWithProductDetails.description: Open each product page to add description, full specifications, MOQ, contact number, GST, IEC and company details. Adds one request per product.
enrichWithProductDetails.title: Enrich products with detail pages

expandRelatedCategories.description: When a keyword or category has too few listings, also collect IndiaMART's related product categories. Results are de-duplicated.
expandRelatedCategories.title: Expand into related categories

keyword.description: Product or material keyword, e.g. 'cotton fabric', 'industrial pump', 'basmati rice'. Required for mode=searchProducts.
keyword.title: Search keyword

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return across all keywords and inputs.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxPrice.description: Drop listings priced above this amount. Use 0 for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (INR)

minPrice.description: Drop listings priced below this amount. Use 0 for no minimum.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (INR)

minRating.description: Drop suppliers rated below this star rating (0 to 5). Use 0 for no minimum.
minRating.title: Minimum supplier rating

mode.description: Choose what to collect from IndiaMART.
enumTitles: Look up product URLs or IDs
mode.title: Mode

productUrls.description: IndiaMART product URLs or numeric product IDs. Used only for mode=productDetails.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

state.description: Keep only suppliers in this Indian state or union territory. Leave empty for all of India.
enum: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
enumTitles: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
state.title: State or union territory

supplierUrls.description: IndiaMART supplier profile URLs, company IDs, or company aliases. Used only for mode=supplierProfile.
supplierUrls.title: Supplier URLs or company IDs

verifiedSuppliersOnly.description: Keep only suppliers with an IndiaMART verification signal such as TrustSEAL, verified exporter or verified GST.
verifiedSuppliersOnly.title: Verified suppliers only

title: IndiaMART B2B Product & Supplier Scraper Input
